notes.title: Anti-Cheat Protection Is Not Registered in Production
notes.problem: AntiCheatManager defines Creative/Spectator correction for non-admin players, but production main.js never imports or instantiates it, so those subscriptions are inactive.
notes.action: Either register AntiCheatManager from the production bootstrap if the protection is required, or remove the dead module and ensure active arena guards own the intended capability policy.

evidence.finding: AntiCheatManager subscribes to playerGameModeChange/playerSpawn, but main.js creates ArenaService, SetupManager, WorldManager, EventCommandManager, HologramManager and WelcomeManager only.

notes.title: Correct the Daylight-Cycle GameRules Property Name
notes.problem: Build & Decode intends to keep daylight cycling disabled, and the current v1.1.1 world data already stores that gamerule as false. However WorldData uses the key doDaylightCycle while the @minecraft/server GameRules property is doDayLightCycle. This means the world-setup code does not reliably own/reassert that rule if the world state changes later.
notes.action: Correct the existing WorldData/WorldManager gamerule key to doDayLightCycle and keep the same world-setup owner. Do not create a second gamerule authority.

notes.title: Clarify Whether Guessers Should Receive Mayfly During Active Rounds
notes.problem: The active-round role application enables mayfly for every playing participant, including Adventure-mode guessers. The selected artifact does not provide enough evidence to classify this as a defect, but it materially changes how guessers can move and view the build.
notes.action: Confirm the intended guesser movement policy. If flight is builder-only, scope mayfly to builders in both activateRound() and reconnect/applyRole(); otherwise document that guesser flight is intentional.

evidence.finding: Both active-round role paths set ability mayfly true for all playing participants.
